verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own dashboard filtering: you can filter by release, a shared Release filter now has a "does not equal" operator, and there are status-based views such as errors introduced in the last 24 hours. The evidence stops there, so only the release slice of the story is shown, with simple filter operators rather than a query language. missing for 10: cross-project search, filtering by tag/environment/custom metadata properties, a documented query syntax, independent corroboration.
